semantic_review.001_008_hierarchy_identity_capability_no: OV:B0004-B0038 and B0060-B0063 support partial hierarchy, unquoted path/zero-based source roles, roots, canonical parent/path, device-scoped ID/no-object contexts, per-member capabilities and requested-versus-spontaneous distinction. Canonical-parent own-track example is not generalized to nested devices. Allocation/nonreuse/nonstorage prose remains documentary context with null runtime oracles. Polling/notification wording supplies no callback cadence/order/count or architecture. Notification mutation caution and defer guidance are not a universal failure string or deferlow cure.
semantic_review.009_014_live_path: PATH description and B0063-B0103 support path navigation/following outputs, optional initial path, absolute/relative/up, list-member restriction, list count/child names and current navigation path. Existing object versus location is kept distinct. Standalone getid TEXT_HERE is not completed from combined bang/getid or memory; this_device omission in goto root list stays unresolved. All message/ID/error outputs remain null.
semantic_review.015_022_live_object: OBJ:B0059-B0148 support ID assignment/query, object type, canonical path, getinfo role, child versus child-list and scalar versus value-list get/set, and generic call. Source capability predicates are retained: actual writable/callable/readable member must be independently supported. -no output- is not promoted to arbitrary-input silence/rejection, exact IDs/tuple/order/codec, inherited-member closure, mutation/rollback or actual LOM function semantics.
semantic_review.023_persistent_mapping: OBJ:B0153/OBS:B0124/REM:B0082 name Use Persistent Mapping. LAB-023 compares only visible option/current selected state for the indicated bridge, with valid initialized binding prerequisite. Save/reopen/editor moves, cross-run association/path/ID and defaults stay null. Overview nonstored IDs and JS dynamic-ID guidance remain separate contexts rather than a universal nonpersistence law.
semantic_review.024_027_observer: OBS:B0004/B0007/B0061-B0121 distinguish eligible property/current/change role, single-child versus child-list representation, requested bang, assignment and right-output metadata versus left values. No property/capability is invented; unsupported/empty/mismatched/no-object probes require positive observation first. No exactly-once/immediate callback, output-order or complete type schema is inferred.
semantic_review.028_033_remote: REM DeviceParameter eligibility, id0 release, getid, Copy LOM Path, integer/float/signal families, ramp/smoothing and normalized roles are supported. Source single-buffer/sample-accurate, 1ms/default/linear examples remain research context without numeric, interpolation, thread, latency or rate law. Nonparameter/no-effect and release probes have active nonzero paired baselines. Parameter automation/interaction versus active envelopes, saved values and Undo remain separated and ungraded; existing finite automation/gain/unit owners are not broadened.
semantic_review.034_037_thisdevice: INIT:B0004/B0057-B0065 with OV:B0100 and JS:B0004 support automatic full-initialization/reload role distinct from manual bang/double-click/loadbang. Enabled-middle/preview-right description is not silently merged with getstate rightmost device-state wording. Live versus Max/editor context and inactive outlets are retained. Width set/reset and save caveat do not become exact pixels, default sizing or persistence mechanism.
semantic_review.038_044_JavaScript: JS public constructor/callback, follow-object/location, path/id/validity, metadata, get/getstring/set/call and observation roles are supported. Global/high-priority use cautions are not candidate scheduler requirements. No JS version, arbitrary engine compatibility, actual script/callback, ID type/union grammar, encoding or member signature is invented. Printed get number/number-array annotation stays distinct from generic value/list wording and getstring description. All result, notification and numeric expectations remain null.
semantic_review.eight_U_obligations_and17_additional_cas: Version/member/source context, identity/persistence, input grammar/capability, order/readiness, remote ownership, history/cancel/concurrency, loss/recovery and teardown remain explicit U. Proposed nonfinite, rates/block sizes, async/concurrent and lifecycle variants have no expected outcome or guessed timeout, flush, atomicity or rollback. No synthetic Max host, firmware/controller substitute, actual patch/script or executed trace is supplied.
semantic_review.owners_and_versions: New clauses route existing Max host/editor/save/dependencies, Set/rack/Clip/Session/application operations, numeric mix/gain/enum, transport/playback/Warp/MPE/tuning/mapping, finite automation and project/history owners. REQ013 remains unclosed. A generic API bridge does not specify individual LOM member effects. The LOM index declares Live12.4.5, while overview/bridge Max versions are not matched; exact12.4.3 applicability remains U.
